notes.title: Final Update!
notes.notes:
Dear players, thank you for being with us on this development journey! 

We had a lot of fun making this game!

Thank you for being with us even when the updates were scarce!


In this final update we polished the game a lot, here is everything that we made:

- [b]added better controller support[/b]: the players playing with a controller have a smoother experience
- [b]voice over[/b]: if reading is not your thing, the long texts now have their own audio, so you don't have to read if you don't want to
- [b]better music[/b]: we expanded our background music
- [b]achievements correction[/b]: some achievements weren't working properly, now this should be fixed
- [b]reward tiers correction[/b]: some rewards were awarded to the player prematurely, this should be fixed now

As always, backup your save files before updating!

Have fun racing!
